images.author: Maysam Yabandeh
images.why: Explicitly identifies Miñiques behind its namesake lake; blue water, volcanic slopes and grass foreground. Linked version is 1920×1080; source offers a 4032×2268 original.

images.author: Black Diamond Images
images.why: Photographer identifies Miñiques, with golden tussock grass, blue lagoons and brown volcanic slopes. Broad classic landscape; linked rendition is below the preferred 2000-pixel threshold.

images.author: Maysam Yabandeh
images.why: Alternative lakeside composition at Laguna Miñiques. Source lists a 3206×1804 original; the directly exposed image is only 1344×756.

images.author: Elvis Acevedo R.
images.why: Caption explicitly identifies Falso Azufre approaching Laguna Verde, looking northeast from Chile. Strong location match; pixel dimensions and 9:10 crop suitability remain unverified.

images.author: Elvis Acevedo
images.why: Broad massif photograph whose caption distinguishes Falso Azufre and its adjoining summits individually. Chile-side northeast-facing view; dimensions unverified.

images.author: Joël Boyer
images.why: Confirmed western view of Putana with summit fumaroles and snow marking the sulfur-mine road. Excellent identifying features; dimensions unverified. Licence restricts commercial use.

images.author: David Tapia
images.why: Specifically captioned 'Observando al volcán Putana', looking northeast from Colorado on 26 February 2023. Useful elevated alternative; dimensions and crop suitability unverified.

images.author: Katia and Maurice Krafft
images.why: Documented northwest view showing Putana's volcanic edifice and fumarolic summit. Reliable identity and historical photographic provenance; dimensions unverified.

images.author: Carlos Hevia
images.why: Explicitly captioned 'Taapaca desde Putre', matching the requested classic viewpoint. Direct photograph supplied courtesy of Andes Exposures; dimensions unverified.

images.author: David Valdés
images.why: Named Taapaca photograph taken looking northeast on 18 August 2015. Alternative mountain-focused candidate; dimensions and 9:10 crop suitability unverified.

images.author: Oscar González-Ferrán
images.why: Explicitly identified snow-capped Taapaca dome complex above Pampa del Muerto. Broad geological landscape with the summit on the central horizon; dimensions unverified. Noncommercial licence.

images.author: Instituto Geográfico Militar; courtesy of Oscar González-Ferrán
images.why: Confirmed aerial photograph of the chain's southern end, showing multiple volcanic vents and lava flows. Strong identity match, although it lacks the preferred lake foreground; dimensions unverified. Noncommercial licence.

images.author: Yorly Batlle
images.why: Lake landscape explicitly identifying Cordón de Puntas Negras on the right. Conditional crop candidate: retain the right-hand chain, since the central volcano is Miscanti. Dimensions unverified.
